notes.title: Love: A Puzzle Box Filled with Stories review - a unique and gently profound observation of life
notes.notes:
A lady used to love painting but now she works downstairs in a coffee shop and looks miserable. Somehow, art faded from her world. But what if she were to rediscover it? What if, through some benevolent stroke of fate, a reminder from her past were to drop out of the sky in front of her? Would it spark a recovery? Would she find love again?

Two boys are lonely. One has a father who shouts and smashes things and makes his mother scared. Another has a mother who shouts at him for playing music. They live in the same block but they have never met, and now as men, they sit alone. What if you could bring them together? What if you could go back in time and, through some benevolent stroke of fate, ensure they were both on their balconies at the same time and noticed each other? Could it spark a love between friends that would last forever?

This is Love. It's a game about exploring the lives of people who share an apartment block, a game about playing around with time. And it's a game about sometimes delivering the fateful nudge two people need in order for their paths to cross. Really, it's a game about helping people find love.

notes.title: LOVE - A Puzzle Box Filled with Stories Available Now + 10% Launch Discount
notes.notes:
After 4+ years of development, the big day has finally come: LOVE - A Puzzle Box Filled with Stories is now available for purchase!

LOVE is both a puzzle game and a neighborhood that you can be a part of.  Through interactions in the past and the present, you’ll get to know the people that live in your building and the moments that define their lives - and then you'll change them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36823234/817d92042e82f2308d6ee5ec956baceff6095a92.jpg[/img]

We like to think of LOVE as a living diorama that's also a puzzling plaything, and we hope you'll think of it as your new favorite game. :)

During the game's first week, [b]you can save 10% through a launch discount[/b]. We won't be dropping the price again any time soon, so it's a [i]great[/i] time to jump in and see what all the fuss is about. 

Welcome to the neighborhood!

notes.title: Talkin' LOVE: A Developer AMA / exciting timeshare vacation opportunity
notes.notes:

Join us on Thursday, June 18 from 11am-2pm PT for an AMA, and be sure to use the hashtag [b]#thatlovegame[/b] so we can find your tweets. 

We'll answer all of your questions about the game, its demo, our emotion-driven design process -- and if you [i]really[/i] need the help, we'll even store your snow tires in our garage.

Don't forget to set a reminder ⏰ and follow us at [url=http://twitter.com/rocketship_park][b]@rocketship_park[/b][/url]. Come have a socially distanced hangout with us on our virtual fire escape, and we'll see you on the Twitter tweets! 🚀

notes.title: Love A Puzzle Box Filled With Stories looks like a bittersweet treat
notes.notes:
Love – A Puzzle Box Filled With Stories seems plenty simpler than its overwrought name would imply. I often enjoy a short little thinker to tinker with, especially if it’s got a story to go along with it. Love looks just up that alley, with its spinning apartment floors that control past and present until you’ve fixed the mess the characters have made of their relationships. Rocketship Park released an announcement trailer for this little puzzler on Valentine’s Day but it’s about more than just romantic love, they say.
